snippet.title: Reflector Satellites - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
In Reflector Satellites, you play as a space defender fighting off an endless number of enemy ships. Your opponents are ships of three colors: red, blue and yellow. Use mirrors to redirect your shots and destroy enemies more effectively.

Every time you destroy three ships of the same color in a row, you receive bonus points. This requires strategic planning and precision to make the most of your attacks. Assess the situation, control mirrors and destroy enemies to score as many points as possible.

Developed by Xitilon
